content.title: Shine & Go
content.intro: Mobile car wash service that comes to you, using eco‑friendly products to leave every vehicle spotless and fresh.

sections.title: Our services
sections.body: Exterior wash, interior vacuum, tire shine, and full detail—all performed on site in under an hour.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Book online, we arrive at your location, clean your car, and you’re ready to roll.

sections.title: Why choose us
sections.body: Water‑saving techniques, biodegradable soaps, and a satisfaction guarantee on every wash.

closing.headline: Your car deserves the best
closing.body: Experience a clean ride without leaving your driveway.
